test_title: PYST 141: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 31 Jan, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

FVL: MXI :: PCJ : KES :: DKN: ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is :

 
• First letter ⇒ (3) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Second letter ⇒ (2) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• Third letter ⇒ (1) is added to the position value according English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• FVL: MXI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b53780070684358b201db925a14e9e00347642d93292229f08d247eafc1e06df.png] 

And,

 
• PCJ : KES

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39bbff7fe232965f945a342a38b338b206da8370a6ebe3d573a910c8f2a61007.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• DKN: ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f649f45d73c0d7adedcc2014611d31ceb07eb282028d20dbf5ac375c1dcf667c.png] 

​Hence, "**OMG**" is the correct answer.
